review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Elements Elements is building a foundational platform to automate and connect high-stakes finance workflows. We are in advanced beta, live with early customers, and preparing for a full production launch. The product is already operating in demanding, real-world environments. This is a rare moment to join early with real traction and low execution risk. We are well funded, actively used by multiple customers, and seeing strong inbound demand as we prepare to scale. The Opportunity We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer as a foundational team member. This fully remote role offers deep ownership over core services, interfaces, and system architecture as we move from advanced beta to production. You will work directly with the founders and influence technical direction, product decisions, and engineering standards. What You’ll Do Design and build backend and frontend services from the ground up. Own major architecture components as the platform scales. Drive the product from advanced beta to production readiness. Write clean, scalable code using Java (Spring Boot) and React. Collaborate closely with founders in a high‑autonomy environment. Establish engineering best practices as the team grows. Who We’re Looking For Strong understanding of application architecture and system design. Proven track record building production systems end to end. Ability to balance quality engineering with startup pace. Ownership mindset with experience in zero‑to‑one environments. Strong problem‑solving skills and technical judgment. 4+ years of experience with Java, Spring Boot, Python, React, or similar technologies. Why Join Elements Real ownership in a category‑defining product. Meaningful equity as a founding team member. Direct impact on how critical finance systems operate. A small, experienced team focused on building the right way.

review_candidates.title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Java, Spring Boot, Angular)
review_candidates.company: Hash Connect Integrated Services Pvt. Ltd.
review_candidates.description: Experience: 6–7 years Location: Indiranagar, Bangalore (on-site) Employment type: Full-time, Monday to Friday About the role As a Senior Full Stack Developer at Hash Connect, you will design, build and run the applications behind our clients' consumer engagement programmes: CRM, web and mobile applications, real-time data and API integrations, and the platforms that power consumer promotions, offer redemption, claims and payments. You will own features end to end, from Spring Boot services to Angular front ends, working closely with product, design and QA, and using AI-assisted development as an everyday part of how we ship. This role is designed for engineers with 6–7 years of hands-on experience who want to write code every day. We are not hiring at architect, lead or engineering-manager level for this opening. What you will do Design, develop, test and deploy web applications using Java, Spring Boot and Angular Build and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services in Spring Boot Build responsive, high-performance user interfaces in Angular (and Next.js where relevant) Design and optimise MySQL and PostgreSQL databases Work with product managers, UI/UX designers and QA engineers to define and ship features Write clean, maintainable, well-documented code and take part in code reviews Troubleshoot, debug and tune application performance Work with Git and Agile/Scrum practices Mentor junior developers and share knowledge across the team AI-assisted engineering Use AI coding tools (Claude Code preferred; GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar) for code generation, refactoring, documentation, unit tests and debugging Review and validate AI-generated code for correctness, maintainability, performance and security before it reaches production Build effective prompts and workflows that improve team productivity Help the team adopt AI tools responsibly and effectively What we are looking for Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field 6–7 years of professional experience in full stack development Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot Hands-on experience with Angular; Next.js is a plus Good command of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and TypeScript Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs Strong knowledge of MySQL and PostgreSQL Hands-on use of AI coding assistants in day-to-day development Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail and clear communication Good to have Java or cloud certifications Message brokers and event-driven architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ) Microservices and security best practices DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines Testing frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito Building applications on LLMs and AI APIs; exposure to Spring AI, Model Context Protocol (MCP) or RAG About Hash Connect Hash Connect empowers brands to transform the customer experience through the strategic application of technology, data-driven insights and AI. We build CRM, web and mobile applications with real-time data and API integrations, power AI-driven marketing automation and consumer engagement, and run omnichannel consumer programmes end to end: consumer promotions, offer redemption, claims, KYC, order processing, payments and BPO/call centre support. 10+ years delivering excellence | 100+ martech minds | 25M+ consumers engaged | 200+ projects delivered We are ISO/IEC 27001 certified, with offices in Bangalore and Cochin. Know more at www.hashconnect.in Job location Hash Connect Integrated Services Pvt Ltd, 248, Samhitha Plaza, Defence Colony, Indiranagar, 80 Feet Road, Bangalore 560038 Map: https://g.page/r/CUqF_hdFz7ieEBA Working days: Monday to Friday
